data.one_liner: Widget to place box widgets between slivers in a CustomScrollView
data.what_it_does: Provides two widgets, SliverPassthrough and BoxToSliverPassthrough, that convert between sliver and box layout protocols and expose the box scroll offset via a ValueListenable.
use_when: Embedding a box widget inside a sliver list or grid
Needing the scroll offset of a box for CustomPaint or other effects
Simplifying CustomScrollView construction when mixing slivers and boxes
avoid_when: Using only slivers or only boxes
Needing advanced layout features beyond simple box-to-sliver conversion
strengths: Exposes scroll offset for custom painting
weaknesses: Limited to sliver/box conversion, no advanced layout options
No examples for complex use cases
